Niche identification

Source: R/niches.R
nicheIdentification.Rd

Defines niches by k-means clustering of per-cell feature vectors, once with hard cell type membership and once with bootstrap-confidence weights. The features of each cell are its local indicators of spatial association from lisaClust (lisaClust::lisa()) at several radii.

Usage

runNicheIdentification(
  spe,
  cellTypeTree,
  confList,
  toLabels = NULL,
  r = c(20, 50, 100),
  k,
  window = "convex",
  lisaFunc = "K",
  cores = 1,
  seed = 51773,
  cellType = "cellType",
  cellID = "cellID",
  imageID = "imageID",
  x = "x",
  y = "y"
)

Arguments

spe

A SummarizedExperiment (e.g. SpatialExperiment) with a cell ID, cell type, image and coordinates for every cell (see getCellData()).

cellTypeTree

A cell type tree, see cellTypeTree.

confList

Confidence list from bootstrapLineageConfidence().

toLabels

Labels (leaves and/or groups) to build features from; defaults to every leaf and group in the tree. An error is raised for a label that is not in the tree.

r

Radii of the local curves: one or more positive numbers.

k

Number of niches, a whole number of at least 2 and below the number of cells.

window, lisaFunc

The image window and the local function ("K" or "L"), as in lisaClust::lisa().

cores

Number of threads.

seed

Random seed for the k-means clustering, as in bootstrapLineageConfidence(), or NULL for no fixed seed. The same seed is used for the unweighted and weighted clusterings.

cellType, cellID, imageID

Names of the colData(spe) columns holding each cell's cell type label, a unique cell ID (matching the cellID column of confList), and the image it is in.

x, y

Names of the columns holding the cell coordinates. For a SpatialExperiment whose coordinates are in spatialCoords(), the defaults "x" and "y" refer to its first two coordinates.

Value

A list with the feature matrices (lisaMatUnweighted, lisaMatWeighted) and named cell-to-niche vectors nicheUnweighted and nicheWeighted.

Details

For every cell, every label in toLabels and every radius in r, the feature is the local co-localisation of the cell's neighbours with that label (lisaClust's local K or L function, centred so that 0 means no attraction or repulsion). The weighted features count each neighbour with its bootstrap confidence of having the label, instead of 0 or 1 (see confidenceWeights()), and a label's density is its summed weight per unit area.

Niche names (niche1, niche2, ...) are arbitrary. K-means starts from random cluster centres, so the niches depend on the random seed. The unweighted and weighted clusterings are both started from the same seed, so that if the weights made no difference the two sets of niches would be identical.

Examples

data(lungSubset)
data(lungCellTypeTree)
data(lungConfList)
niches = runNicheIdentification(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree, lungConfList,
    r = 50, k = 6)
#> Computing unweighted LISA curves...
#> Generating local indicators of spatial association.
#> Computing weighted LISA curves...
#> Generating local indicators of spatial association.
#> Clustering niches...
table(weighted = niches$nicheWeighted, unweighted = niches$nicheUnweighted)
#>         unweighted
#> weighted niche1 niche2 niche3 niche4 niche5 niche6
#>   niche1  13204     13      0    157      0    164
#>   niche2     19   1946      0     17      1      3
#>   niche3      0      0    396      0      5      0
#>   niche4    194     14      0   8326      0    436
#>   niche5      0      0    166     16    773    426
#>   niche6    233      0      0    109     24   3329
